items.name: dilekce
items.title: Dilekçe
items.author: productdevbook <https://github.com/productdevbook>
items.description: Dense, paper-style grid forms: every field is a cell, errors sit inside it, and the same form renders filled in like a completed document.
items.docs: Dilekçe is a single file with no stylesheet: it uses shadcn tokens only and imports `cn` from the `cn` package. Needs React 19. Import it from `@/components/ui/dilekce` and compose cells inside the form; pair it with your own `<Button>` for submit (`npx shadcn add button`). Docs: https://github.com/productdevbook/dilekce
